title: Bhare darbar mein zainab khadi hai
body:
bhare darbar mein zainab khadi hai
<<MINI>>
haye haye zainab…………… haye darbar
haye haye zainab…………… haye darbar
<<DIVIDER>>
1.falak ne be rida jisko na dekha
bhare majme mein laaye usko aadaan
rasanbasta ali ki laadli hai
2. bohot laachar hai zehra ki dukhtar
<<DIVIDER>>
jhukaye sar khadi hai bint-e- hyder
haya se sar se pa tak kaanpti hai
3. aseeri be ridaye aur khule sar
yeh tha zehra ki beti ka muqddar
<<DIVIDER>>
ilahi kaisi mushkil ki ghadi hai
4.haram zalim ke parde mein nehaan hain
jhukaaye sar ali ki betiyan hai
har ek ke lab pa bas nad-e-ali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5.ab iss se badhke kya honge mazalim
hai mehwe guftagoo zainab se zaalim
qayamat kyun na phir barpa huwi hai
6.koi abbas se jaake yeh kehde
<<DIVIDER>>
ta’aarruf horaha hai aake roke
sada bhai ko zainab de rahi hai
7.diya hai jis ghadi zainab ne qutba
samjh mein kuch nahi zaalim ke aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
chadi hoton pe sarwar ke rakhi hai
8.jo guzri fatima ki betiyun par
raqam kistarha ho pur dard manzar
qalam mein moosvi ke thatthari hai
